promotion_block_reason: Pipeline crashed during setup phase with engine bug; no submission produced.

outcome.fail_reason: Setup failed in <5min with: AssertionError: model_usage key collision after canonicalization: 'claude-haiku-4-5' -> 'claude-haiku-4-5' already present. Two raw SDK keys map to one canonical name; merging would silently conflate their costUSD — fix the canonicalization rule instead.

bug_report.trigger: router mode=aggressive on aptos2019-blindness-detection (UNSEEN), first hit during the setup phase.
bug_report.hypothesis: Aggressive mode cycles more model variants than stable. The SDK is emitting per-model usage with two keys for haiku-4-5 (likely the dated id 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' AND the bare id 'claude-haiku-4-5') that both canonicalize to 'claude-haiku-4-5', triggering the assertion.
bug_report.fix_direction: The assertion correctly refuses to silently merge. The real fix is either (a) in canonical_model_name to keep date suffix when distinguishing, OR (b) in _translate_result to ADD usage for already-present canonical key (and verify pricing is consistent). User to triage.
bug_report.workaround_for_campaign: Use mode=stable until upstream fix lands.

actions_for_future_runs: L65b retried in mode=stable to recover an UNSEEN image-medical data point.
Subsequent campaign tasks (L66+) will also use mode=stable until aggressive bug is fixed.
